assessment: This fundamental Research Advance is of interest to cell biologists studying the mechanisms and control of microtubule nucleation. Rale et al. convincingly establish the regulatory role of the γ-TuNA motif in microtubule nucleation and settle prior conflicting results in the literature. They show that γ-TuNA binds to and activates γ-TuRC-based microtubule nucleation both in Xenopus extracts and in vitro.
